bullets: Built a customer segmentation model in Python using k-means clustering, enabling the marketing team to target four distinct shopper groups and raising email campaign click-through rates by 18%.
Automated a weekly sales-reporting pipeline with SQL and Power BI, cutting the analyst team's reporting time from six hours to 45 minutes per week.
Presented findings on seasonal demand patterns to a group of 15 regional managers, informing inventory allocation for the holiday season.
Analyzed three years of ridership data to identify five bus routes with the lowest on-time performance.
Recommended schedule adjustments that were adopted on two pilot routes, improving on-time arrivals by 12%.
Led a team of four to build a gradient-boosted classifier predicting subscription churn for a simulated telecom dataset of 50,000 customers.
Achieved 84% recall on the churn class and presented a retention-targeting dashboard to a panel of three faculty judges, placing second out of 14 teams.
